public.text: The four identified dimensions are technical, structural, semantic, and organisational. Process or workflow interoperability is included only indirectly under organisational interoperability, although it is essential to acting on exchanged information.
public.suggestedRevision: Explicitly include process and workflow interoperability, or explain that it is a defined part of organisational interoperability. Address roles, trigger events, expected actions, responsibility, and integration into operational workflows.
